allow:
Bash(powershell -Command "
\\$pid = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess
Write-Host 'Current listening PID:' \\$pid
if \(\\$pid -and \\$pid -gt 0\) { 
  Stop-Process -Id \\$pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  Write-Host 'Killed'
}
Start-Sleep 2
\\$after = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Still listening:' \\$after.Count
" 2>&1)

Bash(powershell -Command "
\\$procId = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess
Write-Host 'Listening PID:' \\$procId
Stop-Process -Id \\$procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep 2
\\$after = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).OwningProcess
Write-Host 'After kill:' \\$after
" 2>&1)
